sourceEvidence.title: Quality Systems Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
Strong understanding of industry standards, business operations and regulatory requirements. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in engineering, manufacturing, or a related field preferred. Aerospace industry experience is required. Proven experience in quality management or quality assurance roles. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Familiarity with quality standards such as ISO 9100, AS9100, Six Sigma, or Lean methodologies. Excellent communication and leadership abilities. Proficiency in quality management software and data analysis tools. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship or Valid Permanent Resident status is required.
